generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact valueMin Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/- soon after contract has been issued to bidder

As per Karnataka State Government order No. LD/300/LET/2006, Bangalore, Dated: 01-01-2007 and Government Letter No. PW/134/BMS/2007, Dated: 27-07-2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund and Contractors should follow strictly prevailing rules of labour act

The Tenderer shall obtain the work done certificate in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer District Level Officer and scan the Original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the Bid.
Financial Year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and Thirty First day of March of succeeding year both days inclusive
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
The tenderer shall note that the scanned Documents can also be uploaded in the tasks created under Document/Evidence Required from the Bidder
The Employer reserves the right to Reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reasons
Tenderer shall note that the Tenderer of those found Eligible as mentioned in Clause 3 - Qualification of the Tenderer in Section 2: Instructions to Tenderer ITT, will be considered for evaluation
The rates of all items appeared in Bill of Quantities are inclusive of all leads and lifts
Royalty Charges will be Deducted in every bill of contract as per rules
The bidder is required to maintain the Building executed and completed projects during the defect liability period of 12 months from the date of completion of the work.
Only relevant document needs to be uploaded. un-necessary documents or any kind of fake documents will lead to rejection of tender
GST shall be paid to the tendered amount separately
The Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. The contractor should indemnify the client to that extent

The Item Rates quoted shall include the cost of Royalty charges on constructive materials & other taxes as per the rates prevailing Government Orders at the time of execution and including cost and conveyance of all materials, curing, loading and unloading with all leads and lifts, labour, hire charges of machinery & equipment, etc., complete and all incidental charges. All the items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer- in-charge of the work
Tenderer who meet the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value
The bidders shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of each tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs
To Qualify for award of this contract, each bidder should give all details and documents as per technical and financial bid attached to this tender
The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the standard tender documents KW-3 KPWD and further orders thereon
Period for completion up to 31.03.2027.
Registration Certificate (P.W.D License Class- III & above)
Within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance, the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit for an amount 5% of the Contract price

The Earnest Money Deposit Total Rs. 1,53,400 shall be in two parts 1. Rs. 50,000/- by e-payment, Part 2. Balance EMD of Rs.1,03,400/- shall be in favour of Executive Engineer PWD, Dharwad Division, Dharwad, and may be in the form of Bank Guarantee issued by Nationalized/Scheduled Bank / in favor of Executive Engineer, PWD, Dharwad Division, Dharwad (Contractor should upload the scanned Copy of Bank Guarantee issued by Nationalized/Scheduled Bank. Original Bank Guarantee should be handed over by the bidders to THE EXECUTIVE ENGINEER, PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT, DHARWAD DIVISION DHARWAD.
Any deviation/error/mistake found in units of items,they should be read as in the unified SR 2023-24 -Continued SR, Issue Rates, prevailing orders and the rates shall be quoted accordingly.
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing e-procurement portal
Item for which no rates or price has been entered in will not be paid for by the Employer when executed & shall be deemed covered by the other rates & prices in the bill of quantities
As per Govt circular no GO-FD/AE 263/EXP12-2022 dt 11-05-2022, this clause for owning key equipments for works costing up to Rs.3.00 crores is exempted.
LOC/Letter of Credit should be in prescribed format-2, if not, then the tender will not be accepted
Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27 in the Technical Qualification Criteria mentioned in the next section
Terms and conditions as per KW-3
Estimate Rates are Exclusive of 18% GST
Star rates are not applicable
This bid documents clause No. 34.4 to be implemented as per deligation of power vide GO No. 423 FC-1 2018 Bangalore dated 24.09.2018

technicalCriterionList.description: List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
List of Financial Resources with Certificates
Work Done Certificates obtained from the Competent Authorities
The Tenderer should be a PWD Registered Class III & Above contractor

To qualify for award of this contract each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 Satisfactorily completed at least 50 Percent of the contract value as prime contractor at least one similar work such as Maintenance of Building works of value not less than Rs. 38.33 Lakhs.

3.3) Each Tenderer should further demonstrate: (a) As per this note, each tenderer should demonstrate availability of few key equipments / machinery for execution of the work. However as per Govt circular no GO-FD/AE 263/EXP12-2022 dt 11-05-2022, this clause for owning key equipments for works costing up to Rs.3.00 crores is exempted. However it is obligatory for the contractor to use the following machineries for various activities involved in construction as per Morth specification.1) Excavator like JCB/Hitachi etc , 2)Tippers / Trucks, 3)Road Roller (vibrator) , 4)PRR Roller, 5)Hot mix with plant (minimum capacity of 40/60 TPH), 6)Paver finisher, 7)Vehicle Mounted (tank) Mechanical sprayer, 8)Pug Mill (suitable Capacity), 9) Construction elevator/Building Hoist/Tower Cranes, 10) Water Tanker, 11) Shuttering materials

Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs.23.00 Lakhs Credit lines or letter of credit or certificates from the banks for meeting the fund requirement etc. LOC or Letter of Credit should be in prescribed format as per KW-3 Bid Document. if not attached then the tender will not be accepted
Contact details of contractor Should mention valid Email ID, communication Address, Phone Number

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Annual Maintenance buildings, under PWD Jurisdiction in Dharwad Taluka. For the year 2026-27

itemList.description: Cleaning of office floors, toilet floors, corridors, lobbies, partitions, storage units,  furnitures,electrical  &  electronic  equipments,  doors,  windows, curtains, blinds etc., including cleaning of dust, etc., using suitable bombay broom stick, squezers

External sweeping   and terrace cleaning -   Cleaning of outer periphery like roads footpaths curb stones terrace including removing grass dust etc., to the nearest garbage pit using suitable coconut broomstic,bombay broomstick, squezers /wipers /rubberbru
Clearing Grass and Removal of Rubbish & dumping to outside periphery by manual means. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 201

Providing general disinfection services, spraying of insecticide and pesticide inside and outside the building (flies, bedbugs,lizards, cockroaches, spiders caterpillars etc., including cost of materials labour lead, usage charges of equipments etc., complete.
